title: CamPay Collect API - specification for local_payments
scope_note: Extract, not the full CamPay documentation. It keeps only what local_payments implements: push-to-phone collect, transaction status and the inbound webhook.
Payment links, withdrawals, balance, history, mass payouts and the temporary token flow exist at CamPay and are out of scope (see endpoints_not_used).
Where the official documentation and the sandbox disagree, this file follows what the sandbox returned on 2026-11-24 and says so in the entry's notes.

source.nature: Official Postman documentation, plus the sandbox dashboard and real calls made against the sandbox with a permanent access token.

credentials.permanent_access_token: Shown under API ACCESS KEYS of the CamPay application. Does not expire; regenerable in the dashboard. Server-side only. The only credential local_payments uses to call CamPay.
credentials.webhook_key: Shown under API ACCESS KEYS. HS256 key of the JWT carried by the webhook. Server-side only.

not_used.app_id: Identifies the application in the dashboard. Not needed by the API calls below.
not_used.app_username: Only for POST /token/ (temporary token flow, not used).
not_used.app_password: Only for POST /token/ (temporary token flow, not used).

notes: The scheme word is Token, not Bearer.
HTTP status for a missing or invalid token was not captured (the test tool masked it). Treat any 401 or 403 as a refusal of our credentials.

amounts.format: Whole number of XAF, sent as a string, e.g. "100". Decimals are refused (ER201).
amounts.sandbox_maximum_source: Dashboard banner and ER201 message: "This is a demo system. Maximum amount is 100.00 XAF".
amounts.production_limits: Not documented. To ask CamPay before go-live.

phone_number.format: 237 followed by the 9 national digits, no plus sign, e.g. "237677777777".
phone_number.operator_detection: CamPay deduces MTN or Orange from the number. The operator is not sent.

codes.ER101: Invalid phone number. Observed for a number without the 237 prefix and for a well-formed number of an unsupported carrier.
codes.ER102: Unsupported carrier, per the documentation. Not observed in the sandbox (ER101 came back instead). Handle it like ER101.
codes.ER201: Invalid amount: decimal, zero, or above the sandbox maximum.
codes.DUPLICATE_ATTEMPT: HTTP 429. external_reference already used by a transaction still being processed. Message: "A request with this external reference is already being processed".

notes: The documentation says a repeated external_reference returns the result of the first request. The sandbox answered 429 DUPLICATE_ATTEMPT instead while the first transaction was PENDING. Behaviour after the first transaction ends was not tested.

transaction_statuses.PENDING: Prompt sent to the payer, waiting for the PIN. Default status after collect.
transaction_statuses.FAILED: Declined, failed or abandoned. reason may explain it.

status_notes: There is no expiry status. Leaving PENDING by timeout is decided locally.
Sandbox timings observed: MTN success number PENDING to SUCCESSFUL in about 32 s; Orange failure number PENDING to FAILED in about 21 s.
reason is the string "None" while PENDING and on success, "TESTING" on a sandbox failure.

test_numbers.note: Only these numbers are accepted in the sandbox.

endpoints_used.name: collect
endpoints_used.purpose: Send the mobile money prompt (USSD push) to the payer's phone.

request_body.description: Payment description shown to the payer

request_fields.amount: Required. Whole XAF as a string.
request_fields.external_reference: Optional at CamPay, always sent by local_payments. Must be a UUID4: we send the attempt_id. Returned by the status endpoint and the webhook.

response_fields.reference: CamPay transaction id (UUID). The only key accepted by the status endpoint: store it.
response_fields.ussd_code: *126# for MTN, #150*50# for Orange. Can be shown to a payer who missed the prompt.
response_fields.operator: MTN or Orange, as deduced by CamPay.

endpoints_used.response_errors: See errors. HTTP 400 for ER101 and ER201, 429 for DUPLICATE_ATTEMPT.

endpoints_used.name: transaction_status
endpoints_used.purpose: Authenticated read of a transaction. The only proof of payment.

path_parameters.reference: Value returned by collect. Lookup by external_reference is not documented.

response_fields.amount: Decimal string. Compared with the session amount before a session becomes Paid.
response_fields.currency: XAF. Compared with the session currency.
response_fields.code: CamPay transaction code shown to support.
response_fields.operator_reference: Operator transaction id. Empty in the sandbox.
response_fields.app_amount: Amount credited to the CamPay application after fees.

notes: Sandbox quirk: amount and app_amount stay "0.00" even when status is SUCCESSFUL. A sandbox success therefore cannot pass the amount check. Production behaviour must be confirmed on a real payment before relying on it.
Rate limit not documented. The official SDK polls every 3 s.

inbound_notification.name: webhook
inbound_notification.purpose: CamPay notifies a final status. Used only as a trigger for a status check: its parameters are never trusted.
inbound_notification.configured_in: Dashboard, per CamPay application: one callback URL and a method selector (GET or POST).
inbound_notification.method: GET (query string) or POST (JSON body), as chosen in the dashboard. Accept both.
inbound_notification.sent_when: The transaction becomes SUCCESSFUL or FAILED.
inbound_notification.delivery: Sent once, never retried by CamPay. Can be resent by hand from the dashboard.

notes: Claims observed on the signature field of the status response; assumed identical in the webhook. Not yet seen on a real webhook delivery.
The JWT carries no status, reference or amount. It proves the call comes from CamPay, nothing about the parameters next to it.
Verify: alg is HS256, signature in constant time, nbf and exp with a small leeway. Reject anything else.

test_vector.origin: Computed by us with the claims observed in the sandbox. Not an official CamPay vector.

inbound_notification.expected_response: Any 2xx. CamPay does not read the body.

endpoints_not_used.POST /token/: Temporary token (expires_in in seconds, 3600 in the example). Replaced by the permanent access token.
endpoints_not_used.POST /get_payment_link/: Redirect payment page. Out of scope: no redirect.
endpoints_not_used.POST /withdraw/: Disbursement. Out of scope in v1 (no disbursements).

open_points: Production: are amount and currency filled on SUCCESSFUL? Confirm with one real small payment before go-live.
